## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated (new faults go into the simulator)
- [ ] New or changed engine lint rules cite a source and the date it was read
- [ ] `python scripts/update_readme.py` run if output or rules changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] Docs say what was tested on what (simulator, real PEFT, real engine)
